title: Create and attach an optional add-on
summary: Offer extras only with eligible parent services and account for their extra time and price.

sections.title: Create and attach an add-on
sections.body:
1. In **Services**, select **Add service**.
2. In **Overview**, choose **Catalogue type → Add-on**, then enter its name, base price and active time. Add category and description if useful.
3. Assign its eligible staff and locations and review booking rules. Select **Add service**.
4. Open a standalone parent service and choose **Booking & rules**.
5. Under **Optional add-ons**, select the add-on and select **Save changes**.
6. Repeat for any other parent services that should offer the extra.

sections.title: Check the complete combination
sections.body: Select the parent service in booking and confirm the add-on is offered. Each add-on needs eligible staff and a shared location. It adds explicit appointment and checkout lines and can change the total duration and price.

sections.title: Why an add-on is missing
sections.body: An unattached add-on is not a standalone public choice. Check its active state, qualifications, shared branch and parent link. Removing a parent selection also removes its orphaned add-ons. The catalogue type cannot be changed after creation; make the correct type when adding the item.
